title: Teach your first target
brief:
Cobots are programmed by **showing** them where to go.

1. Use the **Jog** panel to move the arm (try joint mode, then Cartesian).
2. Turn on **Hand guide** and drag the glowing handle at the tool tip.
3. Press **Teach** to save the pose. Rename it to `P1`.
